title: Rams' Sean McVay and Les Snead have reason to smile after Day 2 of NFL draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams' Sean McVay and Les Snead have reason to smile after Day 2 of NFL draft
sources.description: The Rams bolster their tight end ranks, picking Ohio State's Max Klare in the second round of the NFL draft. They also drafted an offensive lineman.
